quick: Arterolane 150 mg + piperaquine 750 mg (1 tablet) once daily
summary: Arterolane maleate is a synthetic ozonide antimalarial developed in India and marketed only as a fixed-dose combination with piperaquine phosphate for uncomplicated falciparum and vivax malaria in adults.
indications: Uncomplicated P. falciparum malaria in adults (12 to 65 years)

dosage.d: Arterolane 150 mg + piperaquine 750 mg (1 tablet) once daily
dosage.n: Not for severe malaria; add primaquine per national policy for radical cure

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Peroxide bond generates radicals in the parasite food vacuole (like artemisinins); piperaquine is a long-acting bisquinoline partner.

relative: Pregnancy, children and adults over 65 (not studied)

lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
monitoring: ECG in patients with cardiac risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
